name: zotero
description: Zotero 7 literature workflow: ingest IEEE/arXiv/DOI/BibTeX papers directly into local Zotero 7 (paper-bridge) and search or read full text via private read-only MCP.
author: Shuieng Yuan
suggestedPrompts: 检查本地 Zotero Paper Bridge 服务状态并列出我的 Zotero 分类目录
把这篇 IEEE/arXiv 论文下载到 Zotero 的 Agent-Inbox 并读回全文总结要点
在我的 Zotero 文献库中检索相关论文并提取核心方法对比
